title: Which recovery pattern do the RTO and RPO allow?

questions.ask: Is a long RTO acceptable, with RPO equal to the age of the last backup?
Short RPO, moderate RTO, low cost, compute started after a disaster?
questions.yes: Pilot light: data replicated, compute as code

questions.ask: Short RPO and an RTO of hours or less?
questions.yes: Warm: replica plus a scaled-down stack

otherwise: Hot: both sides serve production traffic, at the highest cost
before: Habit 3: read a case study like a requirements document
caption: Rows go from cheapest to dearest: the first one that meets both numbers is the design to pick.
